title: Intraday Forecasting Ability and Liquidity Provision of Institutional Traders
abstract: arXiv:2610.31141v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This study uses a high-frequency dataset from a stock exchange to examine how forecasting ability and liquidity provision relate to institutional traders' proprietary intraday profitability. We discover persistent forecasting abilities among traders. Specifically, we demonstrate that hypothetical flow-following strategies based on the execution flows of these skillful traders yield annualized Sharpe ratios ranging from 16 to 63 across various trading frequencies. We match buy and sell executions into positions, linking realized profit and loss (P&L) to horizon-matched forecasting proxies and the liquidity roles of both executions. Our findings indicate a direct correlation between improved forecasting ability and profitability, where a one-standard-deviation increase in the forecasting ability proxy is associated with 1.02 -- 1.19 currency units higher P&L per matched position. translated_title: 机构交易者的日内预测能力与流动性提供
translated_abstract: 本研究利用某证券交易所的高频数据集，考察预测能力和流动性提供与机构交易者自有日内盈利能力之间的关系。我们发现了交易者中存在持续的预测能力。具体而言，我们证明基于这些具有技能的交易者执行流量的假设性跟单策略，在各种交易频率下可产生16至63的年化夏普比率。我们将买入和卖出执行匹配成头寸，将已实现盈亏（P&L）与期限匹配的预测代理指标以及两次执行的流动性角色联系起来。我们的研究结果表明，预测能力的提升与盈利能力之间存在直接相关性，预测能力代理指标每增加一个标准差，每个匹配头寸的盈亏高出1.02至1.19个货币单位。此外，我们衡量了流动性提供强度……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本研究利用交易所高频数据发现机构交易者具有持续的日内预测能力且预测能力与盈利直接相关，基于这些优秀交易者执行流量的跟单策略可产生16至63的年化夏普比率。
